title: Set up the feedback round-up and put it in HQ
ask: Daniel ruled Q-89 option a — itch comments are the channel and the page says nothing new — and set the process: the community manager reviews player feedback at regular intervals and brings it to him. While throughput is low it is enough to show him the feedback itself with links; statistics, escalation rules and deciding what to keep from him come later, when there is enough of it to be a drain.
first_action: Write down the review cadence and where feedback lands, then add the panel to HQ that shows the itch comments with a link to each.
source_message: Daniel ruled Q-89 option a — itch comments are the channel and the page says nothing new — and set the process: the community manager reviews player feedback at regular intervals and brings it to him. While throughput is low it is enough to show him the feedback itself with links; statistics, escalation rules and deciding what to keep from him come later, when there is enough of it to be a drain.
result: Q-89 is in place. hq/README.md records Amara’s Monday-morning and post-release review of the existing public itch comments and says feedback lands in the Player feedback panel on HQ’s dashboard. The public itch page copy was not changed. HQ reads the public page without credentials, renders each available comment with its author, words, date and direct itch permalink, and says unavailable if the page cannot be checked. It adds no statistics, escalation rules or filters. The live service was restarted from the separate service checkout and its /api/feedback endpoint successfully checked the Tiny Farm page at 2026-09-24T08:10:08Z; the public page had no comments then, so no individual comment links can yet be observed live. The live browser dashboard showed that checked empty state and a link to the itch comments section. Three focused feedback parser tests, the HQ work suite, Python and JavaScript syntax checks passed locally. GitHub Actions passed gateway, writing and game tests for the final parser commit at https://github.com/craklyn/tiny-farm-godot/actions/runs/35973480128. Feature commit cfb95b4; parser correction 1aedd0f.

attempt_outcome.reason: Feedback cadence documented, live dashboard and public comment reader verified.

evidence.local_tests: 3 feedback tests; HQ work suite; Python and JavaScript syntax

landed.note: Public itch feedback is shown on the live HQ dashboard with per-comment links when comments exist.
